The real dataset contains NO PVF-style connection type (no thread/flare/socket tokens in any of the 1000 rows). The closest real 'type' attributes are product_type, mount_type, finish_color. This LOV is therefore repurposed as the type/mount/finish dictionary - all entries below are mined from real Part_Desc tokens, verified case-insensitive against the dataset.

mount_type._note: Resolved from Part_Desc tokens; full Mount Type values (Built-in/Leg) appear in the 2 expected-output rows.

finish_color._note: Appliance finish-color codes observed as 2-letter suffices on APPDE rows.
